title: Eaton to announce second quarter 2026 earnings on July 31, 2026
excerpt: Eaton will announce second-quarter 2026 earnings on July 31 before the New York Stock Exchange opens and host its conference call at 11 a.m. Eastern time.
summary: The issuer announcement still establishes the next decisive evidence event after the July 28 technical alert and contains no second-quarter financial results.
